notes: Teacher-approved single-character L376 已 (已經). S04 final is completed personal book return, not planting a tree; 還 at Han index8 is ㄏㄨㄢˊ. Base 95ca55f7 formal through L369. Learner dependencies L371-L375, provisional 親交通往經. Release also needs all earlier lessons including L370. Required playable order L375 → R045 → R046 → L376. R045/R046 after L375 cover L346-L375 with allowed ceiling through L375; neither is in main at claim. Review pair is Release blocker only, outside this package. sentences.imageNotes: 公車站旁，主角媽媽提醒主角小女孩往後站，女孩正從靠近路緣的位置退回媽媽身旁。公車已到站旁，正在低速靠站，車身清楚可見。呈現公車來了，因此先退後等車停穩。女孩留在人行道上，不跨入車道，也不與公車貼得太近。不畫成衝撞、驚險逃跑或已登車。不放站牌文字、路線號碼、廣告、品牌或可讀車牌。

Fixed mother: dark shoulder-length hair, cream cardigan and blue skirt, warm adult face. Fixed father: short dark hair, blue shirt, tan trousers. Preserve family identities from bottom-row references. Bus stop on broad sidewalk in Taiwan. Mother gently gestures for girl to step BACK away from curb toward mother. Girl clearly taking a calm backward step, still fully on sidewalk with ample safe distance. Large plain city bus has arrived and is slowly pulling alongside curb on ROAD, not sidewalk. sentences.imageReuseDecision: New scene: prior L356/L358 bus scenes show seating/queue/stopped bus, not girl stepping back with mother on arrival.
